sourceNotes.rawContent: Brighten your jewelry collection with this premium yellow bamboo-style kada. Crafted with high-quality gold plating, its anti-tarnish and water-resistant properties ensure long-lasting brilliance. This vibrant, nature-inspired statement piece offers a luxurious modern aesthetic that maintains its stunning luster through everyday wear.
